name: Being Lost
overview: Scripture reveals that being lost is a condition from which God actively seeks to rescue us, as demonstrated by Christ’s mission to save the lost (Luke 19:10) and His willingness to welcome sinners (Luke 15:1). Believers are assured of God's presence and protection, encouraging strength and courage without fear because He will not forsake them (Deuteronomy 31:6; Isaiah 41:10). Moreover, God listens to our prayers (Psalms 28:6) and provides angelic guardianship to guide and keep us in all our ways (Psalms 91:11), underscoring His steadfast care for those who are spiritually lost or vulnerable.
